description: A driver's Web Push subscription: the browser PushSubscription endpoint and keys captured on opt-in, used to deliver background push to that driver's device. One row per device/endpoint.

fields.description: The driver this device subscription belongs to.
fields.label: Driver

fields.description: The login the subscription was created under (the driver's session user).
fields.label: User

fields.description: A device is active until the driver opts out or the browser endpoint stops accepting pushes.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: When this device last refreshed or confirmed its subscription.
fields.label: Last Seen

fields.description: The browser PushSubscription endpoint URL the push service delivers to. Unique per device. Treat as a secret.
fields.label: Endpoint

fields.description: The subscription's p256dh public key (client key for payload encryption).
fields.label: P256DH Key

fields.description: The subscription's auth secret (client auth token for payload encryption).
fields.label: Auth Secret

fields.description: The device/browser user agent captured at opt-in, to help an operator recognise a stale device.
fields.label: User Agent

name: Driver Push Subscription
